about: The secrets a job reading CHECKS_RUNNER_<N> (a change check, or a kept.json checks entry) may read by name beside GITHUB_TOKEN, per repository. A repository with no entry holds none. A secret on the machines that check changes is within reach of every change they checked before, so one is added here, in dazzer-io/.github, in the change that reads it, where a reviewer sees it. machine-rule/judge.mjs reads this file from dazzer-io/.github, never from the repository it judges.

dazzer-io/dazzer.reason: exactly those dazzer's change checks read today: ci.yml's remote build cache (TURBO_TOKEN, TURBO_TEAM and its signing key), the project id its schema check names, the token its agent-spec check reads a private repository with, and the read-only token dashboard-contract.yml reads the dashboard's contract with

dazzer-io/dazzer-app.reason: dazzer-app's checks read no secret: its verdict test refuses a secret on any job off a literal GitHub label, a class strict.json keeps
